waitlist.heading: Join the closed test
waitlist.label: Join the ClosenAI closed-test list
waitlist.note: There is no App Store or Play Store link yet, so this is deliberately not a download button. The list gets one invitation and one follow-up when a goal you wrote reaches its date.

pages.question: What does an AI journal actually do with what I write?
pages.title: AI Journal: What It Should Show You
pages.description: An AI journal should link every insight back to your own words. Here is the record, check-in, reflection and outcome loop ClosenAI keeps.
pages.h1: What an AI Journal Should Show You
pages.template: What the AI did / what the AI did not do — a two-column table written from our own data model.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: Insights are stored as their own entity, not as chat copy.
Every insight carries evidence rows you can expand.
The memory screen shows your own sentences, not a rewrite.

pages.question: Why not just use a chatbot as a journal app?
pages.title: Journal App: Entries You Can Revisit
pages.description: A chatbot answers and forgets the thread. A journal app should keep entries you can revisit, compare and check. This is the difference we build around.
pages.h1: Choosing a Journal App That Doesn't Just Talk Back
pages.template: Three questions to ask any journal app before you commit a year of entries to it.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: Entries are queryable records with an origin field.
The growth records screen renders stored entries as list items.
Outcome results default to unknown, so the app does not grade you.

pages.question: What do you actually get from checking in on your mood daily?
pages.title: Mood Tracker: Check-Ins and Trends
pages.description: One-tap check-ins, a 7 and 30 day window and a heatmap you can read. This mood tracker is a record of patterns, not a verdict about you.
pages.h1: Mood Tracker: Check-Ins, Trends and What Came After
pages.template: The 7-day read: three columns — what changed, what stayed, what you will check next week.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: The mood window offers exactly two ranges, 7 and 30 days.
Heat cells are built from check-ins and stay empty when there is none.

pages.question: How do I reflect without replaying the same feelings in circles?
pages.title: Self-Reflection That Ends in Evidence
pages.description: Reflection is worth something when it leaves a claim you can check later. A weekly five-line template and the loop behind it: record, mood, reflection, outcome.
pages.template: The weekly five-liner: what happened, what I read into it, what I did, what came of it, one change next week.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: Insights are linked to the evidence rows that produced them.
The reflection prompt library is 30 entries grouped by function.

pages.question: What should I write on the days I have nothing to write?
pages.title: 30 Journal Prompts, Sorted by Job
pages.description: Thirty original journal prompts, each with a purpose, an example and a follow-up question. They are grouped by what they are for, not by mood.
pages.h1: 30 Journal Prompts Built From What You Already Wrote
pages.template: Pick the prompt by the job it does: reflect, set a goal, or check in on a feeling.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: Prompts carry a function field, grouped reflect 18 / goal 7 / mood 5.

pages.question: What makes self-improvement survive past the first week?
pages.title: Self-Improvement You Can Audit
pages.description: Goal, action, outcome — and the gap between what you expected and what happened. A self-improvement method you can check instead of one you have to believe.
pages.template: The expectation-vs-actual box: what I expected, what actually happened, the gap, one change.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: Outcome rows default to result unknown.
Outcomes only accept stated, acted or structured origins.

pages.question: Can a goal tracker tell me whether I actually improved?
pages.title: Goal Tracker With a Follow-Up
pages.description: Most goal trackers record whether you showed up. This one asks what you expected to happen and brings the question back when the date arrives.
pages.h1: A Goal Tracker That Asks How It Actually Went
pages.template: One goal per week, written as a prediction you can be wrong about.
pages.author: ClosenAI Growth (GROWTH)

evidence.claim: Outcome entities carry a status and a result field.
Growth records render as revisit items in the app.
